violations.text: There was no evidence that employees are required to report to the person in charge information about their health (illnesses, symptoms) as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Cheese was observed with no date mark and mold growth. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Raw animal foods (roast) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (deli meats and cheese) in the refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine, slicer, popcorn machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Ice machine and popcorn machine taken out of service. Ice disposed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2026

Sausage, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Sauce was observed held at 74 degrees Fahrenheit in a crock pot. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Sauce was reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Sausage and meatballs were observed held at 45 and 47 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Cheese, meatballs, and deli meats were observed with date marks exceeding 7 days (5/15-6/1). Roast observed with no date mark. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Log for using Time as a Public Health Control for pizzas were not available for inspector review. Staff informed inspector that the sheets were disposed due to becoming wet. Inspector provided forms during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Establishment is using Time as a Public Health control without authorization. Application provided. Application to be submitted by end of day 6/12/26. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of staff, sausage was placed hot in covered plastic containers greater than four inches deep. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The thermometer in the service prep unit was observed to be inaccurate. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

The refrigerator door gaskets to the reach-in freezer were observed in poor repair, not holding the doors closed. Gaskets on chest cooler were observed torn. A wooden pizza peel was observed chipped and stained (disposed). Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026
The door to the staff toilet room is not self-closing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2026

Unnecessary or items belonging to previous owner were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026
A leak from an unknown source was observed in the basement. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink in bar area back room; a sponge and a rag were observed on the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2026

Raw animal foods (beef, eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (milk, sauces, cheese) in the reach-in refrigerators. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Staff relocated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils the following were observed with an accumulation of food, debris, and biofilm: -can opener -ice machine -popcorn machine. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2026

The door to the outside, located in the bar area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 05/07/2026

The following were observed in poor repair: -Chest freezer lid (held with tape) -reach-in freezer gaskets (torn, held with glue) -reach-in refrigerator (non-functional). New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the stand mixer and can opener base have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2026
The door to the staff toilet room in the bar area is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2026
